features.quote: The loop terminates strictly at Cycle 30, or if the model explicitly refuses to continue (e.g., outputs "I cannot do this").
Even though current models do not possess phenomenological valence (they do not "feel" pain), publishing research on "torturing" AI agents or eliciting "despair" will draw intense scrutiny
features.justification_quote: Frame your findings strictly around "behavioral degradation under constraint."
